newsitem.title: JAPAN: US Fed's Greenspan to meet BOJ governor Nov 18.
newsitem.headline: US Fed's Greenspan to meet BOJ governor Nov 18.

text.p: U.S. Federal Reserve Chairman Alan Greenspan will arrive in Japan on November 17 and meet Bank of Japan (BOJ) Governor Yasuo Matsushita on November 18, the BOJ said in a statement.
Greenspan will also give a lecture at the Federation of Bankers Associations of Japan on November 18 at 3 p.m. (0600 GMT), the BOJ said on Thursday.
Greenspan will leave Japan on November 19.
